easy.def: To throw a ball to the batter.
examples: He will pitch the ball.
The pitcher pitched fast.
She pitched the ball.

more.def: To throw the ball in baseball toward the batter.
examples: He pitched the ball right over the plate.
The coach pitched to each player during practice.
She pitched all nine innings.

easy.def: To set up a tent.
examples: We pitch the tent.
They pitched camp by the lake.
Dad pitched our tent.

more.def: To put up a tent and fix it in place.
examples: We pitched our tent beside the river.
They pitched camp at the edge of the woods.
Dad pitched the tent before it got dark.

easy.def: How high or low a sound is.
examples: The bird sang at a high pitch.
Her voice has a low pitch.
The pitch of the note went up.

more.def: How high or low a musical note or sound is.
examples: A violin plays a high pitch, and a tuba a low one.
The pitch of her voice rose when she got excited.
The tuner checks the pitch of each piano string.

easy.def: The baseball player who throws the ball to the batter.
examples: The pitcher threw the ball.
He is the pitcher.
The pitcher is fast.

more.def: The baseball player who throws the ball for the batter to hit.
examples: The pitcher threw a fast ball over the plate.
He is the best pitcher on our team.
The pitcher wound up and threw a curve.

easy.def: A tall container for pouring liquids.
examples: The pitcher is full of juice.
Pour from the pitcher.
Mom filled the pitcher.

more.def: A container with a handle and a lip for pouring drinks.
examples: The pitcher is full of cold lemonade.
Mom filled the pitcher with water.
She poured juice from the pitcher into everyone's cup.

easy.def: A big fork used to lift hay.
examples: The farmer used a pitchfork.
A pitchfork has long prongs.
The pitchfork is in the barn.

more.def: A tool with a long handle and sharp prongs, used to lift hay on a farm.
examples: The farmer lifted the hay with a pitchfork.
A pitchfork leaned against the barn wall.
The pitchfork has three long prongs.

easy.def: The soft white part under an orange's skin.
examples: I peeled off the pith.
The pith is white.
Orange pith is bitter.

more.def: The soft white layer under the skin of an orange or lemon; or the main point of something.
examples: She peeled the pith off the orange.
The pith of a lemon tastes bitter.
The pith of his speech was that we should be kind.

easy.def: So sad that you feel sorry for it.
examples: The kitten gave a pitiful cry.
The pitiful puppy was wet.
It looked pitiful.

more.def: Very sad, in a way that makes you feel sorry.
examples: The kitten gave a pitiful cry from the rainy yard.
The pitiful puppy shivered in the cold.
The garden looked pitiful after the long dry spell.

easy.def: A sad feeling for someone who is having a hard time.
examples: I felt pity for the lost puppy.
She felt pity for him.
The story filled me with pity.

more.def: A feeling of sorrow for someone who is in trouble or pain.
examples: He felt pity for the lost kitten shivering in the rain.
She looked at the old man with pity.
The children showed pity for the hurt bird.

easy.def: Something that makes you sad or sorry.
examples: It is a pity you cannot come.
What a pity it rained!
It's a pity the game ended.

more.def: A cause for sadness or disappointment.
examples: It is a pity that you missed the show.
What a pity the picnic was canceled.
It would be a pity to waste this good food.

easy.def: In a way that shows you feel sorry for someone.
examples: She looked at him pityingly.
He smiled pityingly.
They glanced pityingly.

more.def: In a way that shows you feel sorry for someone.
examples: She looked pityingly at the lost kitten.
He smiled pityingly at the tired runner.
They glanced pityingly at the wet dog.

easy.def: To turn on one spot.
examples: The player will pivot.
She pivoted on one foot.
He pivoted to face me.

more.def: To turn around on one point.
examples: The basketball player pivoted on one foot.
She pivoted to face the speaker.
The door pivots on a hinge.

easy.def: The point something turns on.
examples: The pivot is in the middle.
A pivot is a point.
The door has a pivot.

more.def: The central point or pin on which something turns.
examples: The seesaw turns on a pivot in the middle.
The door swings on a pivot.
The pivot is the center of the wheel.

easy.def: A tiny magical person in stories.
examples: The pixie flew.
A pixie lived in the flower.
The pixie had wings.

more.def: A tiny, magical creature in fairy tales that likes to play tricks.
examples: The pixie hid in the flower in the story.
A pixie danced on the mushroom.
In the tale, pixies played tricks on travelers.

easy.def: A round, flat bread with cheese and tomato.
examples: I love pizza.
We ate pizza for dinner.
The pizza is hot.

more.def: A flat, round bread baked with tomato sauce, cheese and other toppings.
examples: We ordered a pizza with cheese.
Pizza is baked in a hot oven.
She added mushrooms to her pizza.

easy.def: Excitement and style.
examples: The show had pizzazz.
She dressed with pizzazz.
It needs pizzazz.

more.def: A lively, stylish quality that makes something exciting.
examples: The show had real pizzazz.
She added pizzazz to the outfit with a scarf.
The dance routine needed more pizzazz.
